title: Properties panel: context-sensitive inspector
description: Flash 8 Properties panel shows different controls depending on selection: no selection = document properties (fps, size, bg color); shape selected = fill/stroke color, line weight; text field selected = font, size, style, type, color; symbol instance selected = swap symbol, instance name, color effect, blend mode (defer to InstancePanel if already open). Implement as a docked bottom panel in Shell.tsx. Start with document and shape property views. See docs/03-drawing-shapes.md and docs/05-symbols-library.md.
